This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Biology and appearance==
This humanoid [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|tan]] skin, large black [[eye]]s, and exposed nostrils.<ref name="TFA" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TFA Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> a member of this species was present at [[Takodana Castle]] when the [[First Order]] destroyed the [[Hosnian system]] and invaded the planet [[Takodana]] in search of the [[droid]] [[BB-8]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Dark-Eyed-Species-Concept.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art by Luke Fisher]]
The species made their debut in the [[2015]] film {{Film|VII}}, directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TFA" /> They were originally designed by concept designer [[Luke Fisher]].<ref name="Krop">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/lukefisher/#/|text=Luke Fisher|author=Fisher, Luke|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250414022620}}</ref>
